title: What my Zylo spec forgot

segments.text: Here's how to reverse engineer Zylo from a written spec. Claude passed all thirty-one checks, but my spec never said where a late cancellation goes.
The full spec is free at personal software factory dot com. If you build it, tell me what broke. I'm Sam. See you tomorrow.

note: Second Short for F11 Zylo, 2026-11-02. Sources: rulesrc from long render 43.5 s (right card masked), gapsrc 114.2 s -> 116.5 s, untsrc 128.5 s. Uploaded https://youtube.com/shorts/YzXKruYtTck
